description_en: Modifies the Operations and Maintenance (O&M) task configuration for a MongoDB instance
description_zh: 修改mongoDb实例的运维任务配置
name: ModifyActiveOperationMaintenanceConfig

parameters.help_en:
The cycle type.

Month: monthly

Week: weekly
parameters.help_zh:
周期类型。

Month 每月
Week 每周
parameters.name: cycle_type

parameters.help_en:
The day of the cycle.

If CycleType is set to Month, enter a number from 1 to 28 to specify the day of the month. Use a comma (,) to separate multiple days.

If CycleType is set to Week, enter a number from 1 to 7 to specify the day of the week. Use a comma (,) to separate multiple days
parameters.help_zh:
周期时间。

当CycleType为Month，输入1～28的数字，表示每月几号，用","拼接。
当CycleType为Week，输入1～7的数字，表示每周星期几，用","拼接
parameters.name: cycle_time

parameters.help_en: The start time of the O\&M window for the instance. The time is in the HH:mmZ format and is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 实例运维开始时间，格式为HH:mmZ，UTC时间
parameters.name: maintain_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the O\&M window for the instance. The time is in the HH:mmZ format and is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 实例运维结束时间，格式为HH:mmZ，UTC时间
parameters.name: maintain_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the configuration is enabled.

1: enabled

2: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否生效 
1 生效 
2 无效
parameters.name: status
